args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, contradicting FIN-212 (banker's rounding / `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) which `tests/test_money.py` enforces. This caused the nightly build to fail.

## Change
Switch `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. Example:
- `Decimal("2.675")` → `2.68` (7 is odd, rounds up to even)
- `Decimal("2.665")` → `2.66` (6 is even, stays even)

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` passed on this branch.
